shot.title: 跳舞：开始慢慢转半圈
shot.start_end_and_action: Medium-wide smartphone view from the southwest edge of the courtyard dance floor at dusk. The same bride and groom begin a gentle slow dance. Groom holds her right hand in his left, his right hand resting at her upper back. They take two small coordinated steps and start a modest clockwise half-turn as seen from above. Keep full torsos and feet visible, familiar warm string lights, tree trunk and arcades fixed. Camera stays in place with a small pan following their turn. End during the turn before they face one another in the new direction. Do not spin quickly or lift the bride.
